北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京小雨，体感 28℃。出门带伞，注意防潮哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing, light rain and humid. Grab an umbrella and stay dry!
北京.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降9℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云，体感 32℃。多补充水分，小心别中暑！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi, partly cloudy, feels like 32℃. Stay hydrated and avoid heatstroke!
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海体感 35℃！记得多喝水，防晒避暑很重要哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai feels like 35℃! Remember to hydrate and protect yourself from the sun.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天潮湿，体感 30℃。注意除湿，保持清爽哟！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is overcast and humid, feels like 30℃. Stay cool and comfortable!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感 29℃。湿度高，注意清爽透气。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is overcast, feels like 29℃. High humidity, dress lightly!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州 33℃，体感 34℃。注意防晒避暑，多喝水哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou 33℃, feels like 34℃. Stay cool, hydrated, and protected from the sun.
杭州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京体感 37℃，小心中暑。多喝水，户外活动要谨慎！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing feels like 37℃. Beware of heatstroke; stay hydrated and limit outdoor activities!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 30℃。天气稍闷，保持心情愉快！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast, feels like 30℃. A bit muggy, stay cheerful!
成都.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉体感 36℃！记得多补水，午后防暑别大意哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan feels like 36℃! Hydrate well and take care in the afternoon heat.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，湿度 95%。体感 25℃，注意防潮保持舒适。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast with 95% humidity, feels like 25℃. Stay comfortable and dry!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，体感 27℃。湿度高，衣着轻便保持干爽。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing, partly cloudy, feels like 27℃. High humidity, wear light clothes!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 32℃，风力 4级。注意防风，多喝水哦。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like 32℃ with strong winds. Stay hydrated and mind the wind!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天，体感 31℃。湿度大，注意防潮和防晒哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny, feels like 31℃. High humidity, protect from sun and dampness!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感 20℃。温差不大，感觉很舒适呢！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast, feels like 20℃. A pleasant and comfortable day!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾，体感 30℃。出门注意交通安全，小心湿滑！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is foggy, feels like 30℃. Drive safely and watch for slippery conditions!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴天，体感 32℃。湿度高，记得防晒，多喝水！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny, feels like 32℃. High humidity, stay hydrated and sun-protected!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴天，体感 30℃。湿度较高，出门做好防晒。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny, feels like 30℃. High humidity, remember your sun protection!
大连.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃
